rationale: The buyer is a self-hosted infrastructure operator or DevOps engineer — a category that strongly expects free solutions (Stack Overflow, GitHub issues, official docs) and rarely pays for nginx configuration help. Willingness to pay is very low: this is a configuration quirk with a workaround (use IP addresses instead of hostnames, or a custom resolver), not a compliance or revenue-critical blocker. The signal is a single forum post with no upvotes cited, and there is no identifiable channel to reach this audience at scale for a paid product.
solution_plan: This is not viable as a paid product. The problem is a narrow nginx configuration edge case affecting self-hosted operators who will find a free Stack Overflow answer before they'd pay for anything. Even if a Claude-powered nginx configuration advisor could be built cheaply, there is no realistic monetization path — the ICP expects free tooling and the pain is too mild and infrequent to justify a subscription. Do not build.
notes: Fails willingness_to_pay (2 < 5), buyer_clarity (3 < 6). Signal strength is 1 and the problem has free workarounds readily available. Drop.
